role: Score for the OpenScout Reimagined flagship film (55.000 s). Eerie and spacious with a restrained, legible pulse, as briefed.
provenance_summary: A NEW master of an EXISTING raw MiniMax generation owned by the operator. Not a fresh generation, and not a copy of an existing master.

generation_not_attempted.reason: MiniMax Music was not reachable in this environment. readMusicModelConfig() requires a keyed music slot or MINIMAX_API_KEY; .data/provider.json carries empty apiKey strings on both the llm and vlm slots and MINIMAX_API_KEY is unset.
generation_not_attempted.consequence: scripts/generate-montage-score-v3-beat.ts cannot run here, so no new cue could be generated for this era.
generation_not_attempted.remedy: Set MINIMAX_API_KEY and re-run the generator, then re-run this masterer against the new raw file. Picture is unaffected: only edit-reimagined.ts `score` and a re-render are needed.

raw_source.origin: Generated through the operator's own MiniMax account by scripts/generate-montage-score-v3-beat.ts on 2026-08-12 for the V3 work. Prompt asked for an eerie, spacious electronic instrumental with a real but restrained pulse, no vocals and no EDM gestures.

overlap_with_v3_master.note: This window opens 10.007 s earlier and runs 10.083 s longer than the V3 Edit A master, but roughly 82% of its material is shared with it. The two films therefore share a musical identity. Recorded here rather than glossed over.

window.why_this_window: The raw generation's first ~56 s is a 10-second phrase cycle decaying to near silence between phrases (troughs of -42 to -52 dBFS at 6-8, 16-18, 26-28, 36-38 and 46-48 s), which reads as dropouts under picture. 56-108 s is the sustained locked section. This window opens just inside the lift into it and ends where the arrangement thins naturally.
window.downbeat_alignment: Six bars before the measured downbeat the V3 master was cut from (62.256 s), in the delivered 143.9 BPM timebase (bar = 1.66782 s).
window.no_crossfade: A single continuous window. No splice, so the pulse stays phase-continuous for the whole film.

tempo.consequence: One bar is exactly 50 frames at 30 fps. The picture is 33 bars (29 content + 4 outro) = 1650 frames = 55.000 s, so every chapter boundary lands on a downbeat.

mastering.chain: atempo=1.0006949 → loudnorm(I=-18:TP=-1.5:LRA=9) → aresample=48000 → afade in 0.35s → afade out 3s at 52.0s → apad → atrim to exactly 2640000 samples (55.000s)

rights: Original instrumental generated through the operator's own MiniMax account. No third-party recordings, samples or vocals.
